notes.title: Patch notes for Playtest v0.121
notes.content:
Playtest version 0.121 contains a lot of changes, big and small, that have accumulated over the last few months. They include:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The untargeted portions of your game board now sit below the ground[/b] in 3D to improve clarity
[*] [b]A new electricity mechanic[/b], including new electrified enemies and electric line clear upgrades
[*] An entirely new mechanic, [b]GADGETS[/b]. Gadgets are throwable items with a cooldown that you can use during combat. You can hold one at a time, and can find them in Blue Presents.
[*] A reticle in 3D, with settings that let you toggle it or switch aiming to better match the Shotgun's iron sights
[*] Improved effects for gravity effects (e.g. gravity blocks) in 3D
[*] More controlled RNG for tile queue
[*] New background, goobah enemy, and music for World 2
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy blocks now have a health bar[/b] that appears when you've damaged them
[*] Losing all your hearts from a whiffed target select no longer results in a game over, and will now just give you a punishment row (similar to losing all your hearts in combat)
[*] Board background indicators to tell you what type of line clear you just got
[*] Improved clarity on the board select menu, with Flapper now describing the rewards
[*] Board selection roulette now actually a randomized roulette
[*] Weapon switching hotkeys added to mappable controls
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved default deadzones for controllers, especially in 2D
[*] Asset loading improvements to reduce stuttering when changing modes
[*] Fixed scaling on points from juggling
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] There's a bug with the engine that messes up mouse movement when the game is windowed and positioned at the top-left corner of the display. This mostly concerns windowed fullscreen, but a warning has been added to the game advising you to change resolution or play in fullscreen for now. I hope to fix this ASAP.
[/list]

As always, thank you so much for playing and improving Blocks for Babies!

notes.title: Playtest Patch v0.113
notes.content:
This patch brings a new run menu, improvements to visuals and audio, and several bug fixes .

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Overhauled the in-game run menu with new tabs giving info on the player's items, activatable, and weapons
[*] Added controller sensitivity options (accessible when navigating the settings menu with a controller)
[*] Added new activatable "Mystic Mirror"
[*] Added new item "Lock In"
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash when opening 1-line Green Presents
[*] Fixed an issue where running out of ammo during the Redemption boss returned the player to the board prematurely
[*] Fixed softlock after juggling every block in the active tile
[*] Fixed text scaling issue on smaller cards
[*] Fixed bug where punching midair blocks froze them
[/list]
[h2]Other changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased effect and range of sensitivity options
[*] Improve World 1 skybox
[*] Added audio effects during certain scenarios
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Patch 1
notes.content:
This patch directly addresses feedback and issues from the beginning of playtesting. It is focused on small, specific fixes, rather than larger design changes.

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bullet blocks now show up in 3D, and give 1 ammo when destroyed
[*] Introduced a brief delay before target selection, to prevent misclicks
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where getting all items crashes the game
[*] Fixed issue where juggled corrupted blocks aren't cleared from the board
[*] Fixed issue where quitting tutorial early blocked you from ever getting the tutorial reward 
[/list]
[h2]Other changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Moved volume settings from pause screen to settings menu
[*] Corrupted blocks visibly react to clear attempts in 2D
[*] Boss key target selection now covers entire board
[*] Changed "Goal Reached" screen to take mouse input instead of keyboard
[*] Added larger fonts to better serve 4K resolution
[/list]
